name: ganirelix
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Ganirelix acetate injection is indicated for the inhibition of premature LH surges in women undergoing controlled ovarian hyperstimulation.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS Ganirelix acetate injection is contraindicated under the following conditions: Known hypersensitivity to ganirelix acetate or to any of its components. Known hypersensitivity to GnRH or any other GnRH analog. Known or suspected pregnancy (see PRECAUTIONS ).
interactions: Drug Interactions No formal drug-drug interaction studies have been performed.
